mapper.select: SELECT R.ORG_MSTR_CODE AS regionCode, R.ORG_MSTR_NAME_HAN AS name, (IFNULL(R.USE_IND, 'N') = 'Y') AS active FROM ORGMSTR R ORDER BY R.SORT_NO, R.ORG_MSTR_CODE
SELECT D.ORG_MSTR_CODE AS regionCode, D.ORG_CODE AS districtCode, D.ORG_NAME_HAN AS name, (IFNULL(D.USE_IND, 'N') = 'Y') AS active FROM ORGDTL D ORDER BY D.ORG_MSTR_CODE, D.SORT_NO, D.ORG_CODE

SELECT D.ORG_MSTR_CODE AS regionCode, D.ORG_CODE AS districtCode, D.ORG_NAME_HAN AS name, 1 AS active FROM ORGDTL D JOIN ORGMSTR R ON R.ORG_MSTR_CODE = D.ORG_MSTR_CODE WHERE IFNULL(D.USE_IND, 'N') = 'Y' AND IFNULL(R.USE_IND, 'N') = 'Y' ORDER BY D.ORG_MSTR_CODE, D.SORT_NO, D.ORG_CODE
